# Spec

### MCP exposure

Decision: required

| Operation | Tool | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| list connections | thunderid_list_connections | read |
| GET /connections/{id} | getConnection | read |
| POST /connections | thunderid_create_connection | admin |
| DELETE /connections/{id} | deferred soon | destructive |
| PUT /connections/{id} | deferred #7 | |
| POST /connections/{id}/test | not exposed: runs a live request | sometimes |
| POST /connections/{id}/rotate | not exposed | |
| POST /connections/{id}/disable | not exposed: | |
| PATCH /connections/{id} | thunderid_patch_connection |
